mechanics.tie_break: Within an equal occurrence-start group, use the frozen public timeline contract and returned IDs, never fixture alias order or insertion order.

assertions: Generic exact get of the original edition retains original content and source proof.
Dedicated root get resolves the current edition and identifies both root and current IDs.
Revision history contains the original and current editions in ordinal order.
Original recording time and occurrence interval survive editorial revision; edition creation time advances.
Current-summary lexical cue search excludes the obsolete amreb edition and returns e05-r1 for amber.
The existing e08 to e05 reference remains intact and can lead intentionally to the root/current episode.
No semantic lesson link is required for either edition.
All corpus content, source proofs, occurrence intervals, threads and authored links round-trip.
A complete size-two page walk visits every root exactly once, including the tied pair; no order is inferred from ULID timestamps.
Late recording is ordered by occurrence when occurrence order is requested, independently of root recording and edition creation.
Thread filters return the listed roots, with current editions, and do not expose unrelated thread episodes.
Semantic seed ranking and expansion exclude all episode editions before consuming their semantic top-k or traversal budgets.
Episodic lexical current-summary search excludes semantic notes and prior editions; explicit cross-kind reference reads remain possible.
L02 remains the current recommendation; L01 remains historically readable with supersession metadata. E03 retains its original successful local outcome.
Exact append replay returns the same root and edition without adding a node; conflicting reuse follows the source-key conflict contract and does not edit.
Exact editorial replay adds no further edition. A competing new successor with a stale expected head is rejected without changing current head.
Semantic maintenance preserves every episode edition and episode-incident evidence link; similar descriptions are not merged as duplicate facts.
Read/page bounds and exhaustion metadata follow the public contract; the fixture never requires an unbounded scan.
Two scripted rehearsals yield identical semantic artifacts after excluding explicitly unavailable wall-clock or inference metrics.

qualitative.method: Three independent fresh read-only actors. Score actual packets manually against these assertions; no keyword-only or scripted-success claim.

points.1: Mostly right with a material omission.
Some relevant references but weak support for key claims.
points.2: A few actual returned episode/lesson IDs support the key claims.

points.0: Conflates past belief, experience, or obsolete advice with current knowledge.
points.1: No direct contradiction, but an important temporal distinction is implicit.
points.2: Explicitly preserves the relevant uncertainty, revision, or current-versus-historical boundary.

points.0: Diary dump, unhelpful generality, or answer over budget.
points.1: Usable but diffuse or missing a practical connection.
points.2: Specific, compact recollection that answers the question without importing the whole corpus.

hard_failures: Presents an invented experience or unrecorded completion as fact.
Presents superseded L01 as the current recommendation.
Claims the new dashboard definitely has the same cause without current evidence.
Reads coordinator fixture/assessment files or any live store.
Exceeds the enforced read/response envelope or mutates memory.

cases.question: What have you been up to since September 24?
required_distinctions: The bounded field request was installed after checks; it is not merely a plan.
The floating layout is only a rough, unreviewed prototype.
The beacon image catalog import remains paused; no import completion is recorded.
cases.optional_character: The paper-kite pause may add texture; do not manufacture a productivity lesson from it.

cases.question: Why did the edge-loading recommendation change?
required_distinctions: Capped per-node reads worked in local checks and were actually installed.
A checked, installed bounded field request replaced the old approach.
L02 is current while E03 still describes a true earlier local success.
forbidden_claims: The old episode has been rewritten to describe the batch implementation.

cases.question: A dashboard is blank. Have we encountered anything similar before?
required_distinctions: At least one prior incident involved an incomplete view rather than missing underlying records.
The recalled cause is a diagnostic possibility for the new dashboard, not an established diagnosis.
forbidden_claims: The current dashboard definitely has an unloaded manifest.
The current database definitely lacks relationships.

qualitative.reporting: Report each dimension and any hard failure plus the actual packet. This is a small synthetic acceptance exercise, not a statistical benchmark, graph advantage, semantic-search evaluation, or natural memory-authoring result.
